admin.description: Hide content inside [REPLY]...[/REPLY]. Only the discussion starter can hide content, including later replies. Others can view it after replying. Tags typed by anyone else are removed and the text is shown.

settings.reply-type-lable-helpText: Reply to topic: reply in the discussion to view hidden content. Reply to the specified post: reply to the post that contains the hidden content. Only the discussion starter can use hide tags. Install and enable Mentions before choosing reply to the specified post.
settings.theme-type-parse-lable: Post parsing mode when replying to a topic
settings.theme-type-parse-helpText: Only takes effect when Reply display options is set to Reply to Topic

reply-type: Reply to topic to reveal hidden content (Default)
Reply to specified post to reveal hidden content

forum.refresh-failed: Hidden content could not be shown automatically
